reasons.plausibility: Reducing Mo to lower electronegativity disparity and improve plasticity while preserving strength is scientifically sound and aligns with known BCC alloy behavior, though it simplifies a complex multi-element interaction.
reasons.testability: A clear route is proposed: systematically vary Mo content, measure compression strength and plastic strain, and confirm phase stability by XRD—this directly tests the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a tangible, focused intervention (tuning Mo content) to address strength-ductility trade-offs in NbZrTiHfMo, which is highly relevant to alloy design in this systems family.
